title: Radio sandbox-ai
description: A short radio show about what the agent did today, spoken by a local voice, recorded inside the sandbox; only the provider.

de.title: Radio sandbox-ai
de.description: Eine kurze Radiosendung darüber, was der Agent heute getan hat, gesprochen von einer lokalen Stimme, aufgenommen in der Sandbox; nur der Anbieter.

prompt: Read what happened in this workspace today (git log, recent files) and write a two-minute radio show about it: a host, a guest, one jingle. Then make it audible with whatever speech synthesis is installed (espeak-ng, piper) into /work/radio/show.wav, and the script into /work/radio/show.md.
notes: Sound and voices: the media variant (sandbox-ai images recipe media --from AGENT; sandbox-ai build media), then add --image-variant media.
The sound stays inside the sandbox (a null sink): the show is the file /work/radio/show.wav.
